sub.id: Informasi perawatan gigi dan lokasi Batuceper serta Ciledug.
sub.en: Dental care information and locations in Batuceper and Ciledug.

ringkas.id: Tanyakan pemeriksaan untuk menentukan kebutuhan pembersihan karang gigi.
ringkas.en: Ask about an assessment of your dental cleaning needs.

ringkas.id: Dokter perlu memeriksa kondisi gigi sebelum menentukan tindakan.
ringkas.en: A dentist needs to assess the tooth before recommending a procedure.

ringkas.id: Diskusikan pilihan penggantian gigi dan kebutuhan pemeriksaan.
ringkas.en: Discuss tooth replacement options and assessment needs.

ringkas.id: Tanyakan tahapan pemeriksaan serta rencana kontrol sesuai kondisi gigi.
ringkas.en: Ask about assessment steps and follow-up planning for your teeth.

penjelasan.id: Lihat alamat Batuceper dan Ciledug, lalu siapkan pertanyaan tentang jadwal sebelum menghubungi admin.
penjelasan.en: Review the Batuceper and Ciledug addresses, then prepare scheduling questions for the team.

fitur_khas.alasan_dipilih: Dua lokasi tercantum pada website resmi.

a.id: Website mencantumkan Batuceper di Jalan Halim Perdana Kusuma No.56–60 dan Ciledug di Jalan Raden Saleh, depan Masjid Agung. Pastikan lokasi saat membuat janji.
a.en: The website lists Batuceper at Jalan Halim Perdana Kusuma No.56–60 and Ciledug at Jalan Raden Saleh, opposite Masjid Agung. Confirm your location when booking.

q.en: How do I book a visit?

a.id: Untuk Batuceper, tanyakan jadwal melalui 0896-3593-9818. Sebutkan cabang yang Anda tuju dan tunggu konfirmasi admin.
a.en: For Batuceper, ask about availability at 0896-3593-9818. Specify your preferred location and wait for confirmation.

q.en: Is the practice open on Sunday?

a.id: Direktori mencantumkan Batuceper buka setiap hari 10.00–20.00 WIB. Jam dapat berubah; konfirmasikan terlebih dahulu. Jadwal Ciledug belum terverifikasi.
a.en: A directory lists Batuceper as open daily from 10 am to 8 pm WIB. Confirm current hours before visiting. Ciledug hours have not been verified.

q.en: What are the examination and treatment fees?

a.id: Harga belum tersedia dalam sumber yang dibaca. Tanyakan rincian biaya; kebutuhan tindakan perlu dinilai dokter.
a.en: Prices were unavailable in the sources reviewed. Ask for a fee breakdown; treatment needs require a dentist’s assessment.

a.id: Informasi kerja sama asuransi belum ditemukan. Sebutkan penyedia dan jenis polis saat bertanya kepada praktik.
a.en: Insurance arrangements have not been confirmed. Provide your insurer and policy type when asking the practice.
